verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents controls for how long Bolna retains call data, recordings or transcripts, or any way to delete them. Indian data residency, self-hosting and the call-summary toggle are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls. The axis clearly applies to a voice AI platform that stores call data, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
